data.one_liner: Create custom animations and staggered property tweens in stateless widgets.
data.what_it_does: Simplifies creating custom animations in stateless widgets using animation builders, movie tweens for multi-property animations, and mixins for controller management. It includes developer tools for scrubbing and debugging animations.
use_when: You need to animate multiple properties or create staggered animations easily.
You want to build custom animations inside stateless widgets without heavy boilerplate.
avoid_when: You are already heavily using alternative animation packages like flutter_animate.
You require complex physics-based motion engines better suited by specialized physics libraries.
strengths: Easy creation of custom animations in stateless widgets
Supports staggered and multi-property animations via MovieTween
Built-in developer tools for pausing, scrubbing, and debugging
weaknesses: Requires learning its custom builder and tween API conventions

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers an extensive chainable extension-based animation API for Flutter widgets.

alternatives.name: animate_do
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a collection of pre-made ready-to-use entrance and attention animations.
